zh.prompt: 研究显示：每周运动 150 分钟的人，心血管疾病风险显著更低。据此，关于「运动与健康」能得出多强的结论？
hints: 证据支持的是「适量运动有益」，不是「包治百病」
也别滑向另一极——数据确实支持运动有价值
结论的强度必须与证据的强度匹配
zh.explanation: 这份证据能得出「适量运动显著改善心血管健康」，但推不出「包治百病」，也推不出「运动无用」。结论的强度必须与证据匹配——太强是过度引申，太弱是忽视证据。会提问的人，知道该给结论配多大的力气。

en.prompt: Research shows that people who exercise 150 minutes a week have significantly lower cardiovascular risk. Based on this, how strong a conclusion about "exercise and health" is reasonable?
hints: The evidence supports "moderate exercise helps", not "cures all"
Do not slide to the other extreme either — the data does support exercise
The strength of a conclusion must match the strength of the evidence
en.explanation: This evidence supports "moderate exercise significantly improves cardiovascular health", but not "cures all" nor "useless". The strength of a conclusion must match the evidence — too strong is overreach, too weak ignores the data. A good questioner knows how much weight a conclusion can carry.
